body.p: The Content Reuse Finder view helps you locate similar content in your project or in topics referenced in the DITA Maps Manager view. It works with any kind of XML document and can also be applied on HTML and Markdown documents that are not well-formed.
If the view is not displayed, you can open it from WindowShow View. By default, it appears in the top-right section of the editor.
The view includes the following information and options:

ul.li: Scope - The first sentence shows the source scope for the search (Project, or specific project folder, or DITA Maps Manager view).
Enter a list of element names that might contain similar content - You can specify specific element types to be restricted from the search.
Show similar content for the current file - Limits the results to the currently open file.
Ignore stop words - Excludes common stop words (e.g. and or the) from the similarity analysis.

Similarity threshold (0-100%) - Sets the minimum similarity score that content must meet to be included in the results. Values below 100% require a Enterprise license. You can purchase the license from the Oxygen XML purchase page. Possible values are:
100% Identical - Default setting.
95% Near mirror - Small differences, typos.
90% Highly similar - Minor variations, same word order.
80% Same meaning - Similar, but not identical.
50% Related - Similar, but not closely related.
Find similar content - Click this button to start the search.

body.p: Results are displayed in the Results view grouped by similar findings. If you double-click on each group of similar elements in the same Results view, you can see a precise list of elements that are similar.

section.title: Finding Reusable Content with AI Positron
section.p: If the Oxygen AI Positron add-on is installed, it provides two separate features that can help you find and assess reusable-content candidates:

ul.li: find_possible_reusable_content tool - Lets you ask AI Positron in natural language to find reusable-content candidates. The tool uses the same finder algorithm as this view.
Analyze reusable element candidates AI action - Lets you send candidates that were already found in the Content Reuse Finder results to AI Positron for analysis.

section.p: The find_possible_reusable_content tool is available from the Agent, DITA Agent, Planner, and Ask chat modes. For example, ask AI Positron to find identical paragraphs in the current DITA map, locate nearly identical list items in a particular project folder, or identify similar sections that might be consolidated into reusable content.

Based on your request, AI Positron selects the finder settings, such as the elements to analyze, search scope, similarity threshold, whether to ignore stop words, and the number of result groups to return. You can specify these settings in your request when needed. For example, you can ask it to search only p and li elements, restrict the search to the current file or DITA map, or use a 95% similarity threshold.
section.note: Similarity thresholds below 100% require a Enterprise license.
section.p: After AI Positron returns the candidate groups, you can ask it to compare the matches, recommend whether they should be reused, and create or update the reusable content.

To use the Analyze reusable element candidates AI action, select one or more entries in the Results view, then right-click and select Analyze reusable element candidates. The action is available both for grouped results and for the detailed list of matches within a group.
